Messages.Author: Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
Messages.Body:
> Now, really, isn't this piece of equipement a little TOO big ? The only
> drawback I can see is that it will be mucho contested. But seriously :
>

The first drawback is that you have to have a certain capacity range to
use it. If DOM and FOR are big in your deck, chances are that any vampire
large enough will already have some points in those disciplines, thus
reducing the efficiency of the card.

The second drawback is that it takes time to gain the disciplines. In that
time, the vampire can be torpored, the equipment can be stolen or
burned...

The third drawback, which is sometimes an advantage is that when it
changes minions, it loses its counters. So you can't Heidelberg it to your
other minions very efficiently, but at least it's not as cool when someone
steals it.

And *then* it's unique.

> - a Unique Laptop, not for weenie

No, it is not a laptop. A laptop is permanent plus bleed. This is an
equipment that gives the bearer a free computer hack.

> - gives Dom
> - Gives For
>
> For a cost of 1 !!
>

These are all true.

Hi there WES!!

In the RPG, Veddartha is supposedly the name of the Ventrue
Antedeluvian. I can´t recall any reference to any Seal of his. The
Road of Kings book describes a Cup of Veddartha or something, but not
a Seal, and it´s more symbolic than actually magical. He was the ruler
of the Second City after the 3rd generation destroyed the 2nd, and had
access to it´s treasures. Some of which the Ravnos antedeluvian tried
to steal as a favor for Ennoia (Gangrel), his lover at the time, who
was only trying to frame him to be better accepted by her peers. THE
BITCH! Anyway, her plan works, the Ventrue Antedeluvian captures the
Ravnos Antedeluvian, stakes him for the sun on top of the city´s
highest building, where he meets the dawn next day and is destroyed.
Ravnos´little gypsy sister rats on Ventrue and Ennoia directly to Cain
himself, who ressurrects (!) Ravnos and curses Ennoia to walk, smell
and look like the animal she so much loved behaving like. All this
according to a legend in the Ravnos Clanbook.

The cool thing about the Seal is that it gives you a bleed action, it
doesn´t increase your permanent bleed, so you can safely have a
superior Dive into Madness and the Seal for example, and still not be
the target of pesky Justicar Retributions!
